summary: Rechecked 45 layers, 222 targets and all 189 citation occurrences. Two medium findings: a weight-two elliptic-dilogarithm overlap is incorrectly used for a weight-three regulator, and the classical Selmer-group note needs a prime-to-residue-characteristic qualification. No target label or layer verdict needs promotion.
checked: Read accepted AUDIT-30, its full accepted REV-AUDIT-30, all five complete roadmap documents and stage extracts. Reconciled all 45 audited layers and 222 targets: 42 not built and three partly built; 197 absent, 20 partial, three mathlib, one both and one tauceti. This worker neither authored nor reviewed AUDIT-30.

Read all 189 citation occurrences, resolving to 141 distinct declarations in 122 files, at Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 and Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369. Checked multiline statements, local assumptions, structure fields, needed definition bodies and internal assignments. Verified the cited files and supplemental evidence against pinned Git blobs: 133 distinct files in total, with no sorry/admit outside comments; cited declarations are not axioms. This was source inspection, not Lean compilation.

Rechecked all 217 absent/partial target records with declaration-index searches followed by pinned Lean-file searches, organized in 24 topic/alternate-name groups. Covered K-theory, coefficient duality, continuous limits, cycles, norm residue, etale comparison, regulators/polylogarithms, Hochschild and cyclotomic traces, prismatic theory, perfect complexes, support/descent, operations, nerves, homotopy fibres, group completion, spectra, Kan/model structures, spectral sequences and enhancements. Search misses are bounded evidence, not proofs of nonexistence.

Checked all 92 duplicate-lead entries against 70 distinct owner-stage descriptions, each matched to its full source-document section. Consulted accepted RS-08 and RS-18 for motivic and scheme-K-theory boundaries without red-teaming those restructuring jobs. One weight-mismatched overlap was established; the other shared-target/import leads did not yield a further finding.

Challenged search leads for Hodge Tate twists, the ideal Artin map, normResidue on function-field places, log-trigonometric integrals, regular-element projective dimension, Rees algebras, plumbing blow-ups, extra degeneracies, categorical van Kampen colimits, bounded-below injective model structures and uniform-space group completion. Read their actual scope before rejecting them as providers of the missing target. Separately checked Cartan-equivalence hypotheses and coproduct totalization.

Checked the Selmer valuation definition and S-unit map against their unrestricted S/n assumptions; tested the unqualified unramified interpretation on the class of -1 in Q(empty,2). Read Milne Proposition 7.55 and Theorem 7.58 for the local ramification counterexample. This is a correction to the audit note, not a new formalized theorem or a criticism of the Lean definition.

Refreshed guarded repository inputs to main f5284ee51da124df1ab9e01291dc4998eecc100e: no acquired input changed. Publication rechecks those guards. Submitted only the two authorized red-team deliverables.

findings.claim: The duplicate lead identifies the weight-three curve regulator/Eisenstein–Kronecker target with ER.3’s weight-two elliptic dilogarithm construction. These are different weight-specific constructions; the shared series terminology does not establish that ER.3 supplies the weight-three target.
findings.evidence: P.5 target 4 explicitly says “The weight-three curve regulator and its Eisenstein-Kronecker expression”. Its full source section https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/331c5d75baf4bb6cd7b0d8d31a1305438445ffc4/content/campaign/Polylogarithms/README.md#L58-L62 distinguishes the weight-two expression used by ER from the weight-three regulator, and excludes the elliptic weight-three special-value conjecture from Bloch’s weight-two results. The cited owner https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-explorer/blob/331c5d75baf4bb6cd7b0d8d31a1305438445ffc4/content/campaign/EllipticRegulators/README.md#L47-L53 constructs the q-orbit Bloch–Wigner dilogarithm, logarithmic companion and R_q = J_q + i D_q, with their Fourier/Kronecker–Eisenstein descriptions. ER.2, lines 26–43, fixes the regulator as K_2(E) to H^2_D(E_R,R(2)). Neither ER.3’s complete stage description nor that source section claims the weight-three curve regulator. Both full roadmap documents and the matching owner-stage extract were read.
findings.fix: Remove the P.5 duplicate entry for EllipticRegulators:ER.3 as evidence of the weight-three target. If retaining a comparison note, label it an analytic analogy requiring a separate weight-three construction, not an ownership/duplication claim. Retain the valid P.5 → ER.2 overlap for the weight-two eta(f,g) expression, the weight-three target’s absent label, and P.5’s not-built verdict.

findings.claim: The parenthetical equating valuation divisibility in K(S,n) with the unramified-outside-S condition for mu_n omits the restriction at residue characteristics dividing n. The pinned definition permits arbitrary S and n; its valuation condition alone does not impose unramified Kummer classes at those places.
findings.evidence: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/SelmerGroup.lean#L147-L167 proves valuation_of_unit_mod_eq and defines IsDedekindDomain.selmerGroup by valuationOfNeZeroMod n x = 1 at v outside S. The section assumptions impose no condition that n be invertible at those places. Take R = Z, K = Q, S empty, n = 2: the class of -1 belongs because every finite valuation is zero. Its local Kummer class at 2 cuts out Q_2(i)/Q_2, which is ramified: i-1 satisfies the Eisenstein polynomial Y^2+2Y+2. Nontrivial inertia sends i to -i and acts nontrivially on that cocycle, so the class is not unramified. The cocycle formula is also read at https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369/TauCeti/FieldTheory/GaloisCohomology/Kummer.lean#L93-L107. For the local-field facts, J. S. Milne, Algebraic Number Theory v3.08 (19 July 2020), Proposition 7.55 and Theorem 7.58, printed pp.129–131, https://www.jmilne.org/math/CourseNotes/ANTc.pdf (read 2026-09-24; SHA-256 de2066ee7a319c0e6e521895a7e9e9567c2804bcafc0c8e67c417e508f2bc26b), gives the Eisenstein/total-ramification criterion and the maximal unramified field as the inertia fixed field.
findings.fix: Describe the existing declaration first as a valuation-defined classical Selmer group. Qualify the Kummer unramified interpretation by the prime-to-residue-characteristic hypothesis; in the number-field formulation with positive n, require S to contain the finite primes dividing n. Do not infer a Galois-cohomological comparison theorem from the valuation definition or from fromSUnit. Keep crystalline/semistable conditions at p separate and missing. Retain the target’s partial label, its cited classical inputs and the layer’s not-built verdict.
